import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowRight, Minus, Plus, ShoppingBag, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import StoreHeader, { StoreFooter } from '../components/StoreHeader';
import { clearCart, getCart, setCartQuantity, type Cart as CartType } from '../services/cart';
import { formatVND } from '../services/catalog';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function Cart() {
  const { t } = usePreferences();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartType | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    let ignore = false;
    getCart(user.id)
      .then((data) => {
        if (!ignore) setCart(data);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!ignore) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Cart unavailable.');
      });
    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, [user]);

  async function change(id: string, qty: number) {
    if (!user) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      setCart(await setCartQuantity(user.id, id, qty));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to update cart.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function onClear() {
    if (!user) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      setCart(await clearCart(user.id));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to clear cart.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const hasStockIssue = Boolean(
    cart?.items.some((item) => item.stock_quantity <= 0 || item.quantity > item.stock_quantity),
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#faf9f6] dark:bg-[#0b1322] dark:text-slate-100">
      <StoreHeader />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[.22em] text-indigo-600"><Tr text={'Your selection'}/></p>
            <h1 className="mt-3 font-['Georgia',serif] text-[43px] tracking-[-.05em] sm:text-[60px]"><Tr text={'Shopping bag.'}/></h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Review the instruments you've selected."}/></p>
          </div>

          {cart && cart.items.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={onClear}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition hover:border-red-200 hover:text-red-600 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Trash2 size={14} /><Tr text={'Clear bag'}/></button>
          )}
        </div>

        {error && (
          <p className="mt-7 rounded-xl border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300" role="alert">
            {t(error)}
          </p>
        )}

        {!cart ? (
          <div className="my-12 h-40 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900" />
        ) : cart.items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="my-12 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-12 text-center">
            <ShoppingBag className="mx-auto text-indigo-500" size={38} />
            <h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-bold"><Tr text={'Your bag is empty.'}/></h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'Your next favorite instrument is waiting.'}/></p>
            <Link
              to="/shop"
              className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#263247] px-7 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white"
            ><Tr text={'Explore instruments'}/><ArrowRight size={17} />
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-9 grid items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px]">
            <section className="space-y-4">
              {cart.items.map((item) => {
                const overStock = item.stock_quantity <= 0 || item.quantity > item.stock_quantity;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.product_id}
                    className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 sm:flex-nowrap"
                  >
                    <Link
                      to={`/products/${encodeURIComponent(item.product_id)}`}
                      className="h-24 w-24 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-[#f4f1ea] dark:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      <img
                        src={item.thumb_url || item.image_url || '/assets/instrument-placeholder.svg'}
                        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                        alt={item.product_name}
                        onError={(e) => {
                          e.currentTarget.onerror = null;
                          e.currentTarget.src = '/assets/instrument-placeholder.svg';
                        }}
                      />
                    </Link>

                    <div className="min-w-[160px] flex-1">
                      <Link
                        className="text-sm font-bold hover:text-indigo-600"
                        to={`/products/${encodeURIComponent(item.product_id)}`}
                      >
                        {item.product_name}
                      </Link>
                      <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{formatVND(item.unit_price)}</p>
                      {overStock && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600">
                          {item.stock_quantity <= 0
                            ? t('Out of stock')
                            : t('Only {count} left in stock',{count:item.stock_quantity})}
                        </p>
                      )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={busy}
                        onClick={() => change(item.product_id, 0)}
                        className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={13} /><Tr text={'Remove'}/></button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 px-2 py-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={busy}
                        onClick={() => change(item.product_id, item.quantity - 1)}
                        aria-label={t("Decrease quantity")}
                        className="p-1"
                      >
                        <Minus size={15} />
                      </button>
                      <span className="min-w-5 text-center text-xs font-bold">{item.quantity}</span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={busy || item.quantity >= item.stock_quantity}
                        onClick={() => change(item.product_id, item.quantity + 1)}
                        aria-label={t("Increase quantity")}
                        className="p-1 disabled:opacity-40"
                      >
                        <Plus size={15} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </section>

            <aside className="rounded-2xl border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-7">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold"><Tr text={'Order summary'}/></h2>
              <div className="mt-6 flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t("Items")} ({cart.total_quantity})</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">{formatVND(cart.total_amount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold"><Tr text={'Subtotal'}/></span>
                  <span className="text-xl font-extrabold">{formatVND(cart.total_amount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'Inventory is reserved securely when you confirm payment.'}/></p>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={busy || hasStockIssue}
                onClick={() => navigate('/checkout')}
                className="mt-6 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#263247] px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-indigo-600 disabled:bg-slate-300"
              ><Tr text={'Proceed to checkout'}/><ArrowRight size={16} />
              </button>

              <Link
                className="mt-3 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 px-5 py-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                to="/shop"
              ><Tr text={'Continue shopping'}/></Link>
            </aside>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
      <StoreFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

import StoreHeader, { StoreFooter } from '../components/StoreHeader';

const categoryOptions=['All instruments','Piano','Guitar','Drums','Keyboard','Audio'];
const sortOptions:{value:NonNullable<CatalogParams['sort_by']>;label:string}[]=[{value:'default',label:'Featured'},{value:'price_asc',label:'Price: low to high'},{value:'price_desc',label:'Price: high to low'},{value:'name_asc',label:'Name A–Z'}];
export default function Catalog(){
 const {t}=usePreferences();
 const [params,setParams]=useSearchParams();
 const category=params.get('category')||'';const q=params.get('q')||'';const sort=(params.get('sort')||'default') as NonNullable<CatalogParams['sort_by']>;const page=Math.max(1,Number(params.get('page')||'1')||1);
 const [search,setSearch]=useState(q);
 const [items,setItems]=useState<Product[]>([]);const [total,setTotal]=useState(0);const [loading,setLoading]=useState(true);const [error,setError]=useState('');const [retry,setRetry]=useState(0);
 useEffect(()=>setSearch(q),[q]);
 useEffect(()=>{let stopped=false;setLoading(true);setError('');getProducts({page,page_size:12,category:category||undefined,search:q||undefined,sort_by:sortOptions.some(o=>o.value===sort)?sort:'default'}).then(result=>{if(!stopped){setItems(result.items);setTotal(result.total)}}).catch(e=>{if(!stopped)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'Could not load the catalog.')}).finally(()=>{if(!stopped)setLoading(false)});return()=>{stopped=true}},[category,q,sort,page,retry]);
 function patch(changes:Record<string,string>){const next=new URLSearchParams(params);for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(changes)){if(v)next.set(k,v);else next.delete(k)}if(!('page' in changes))next.delete('page');setParams(next)}
 const currentTitle=category?`${t(category)} ${t('collection')}`:q?`${t('Results for')} “${q}”`:t('All instruments');
 return <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#faf9f6] dark:bg-[#0b1322] text-[#24272e] dark:text-slate-100"><StoreHeader/><main className="mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-5 pb-10 pt-8 sm:px-8">

    {!loading&&!error&&total>12&&<div className="mt-9 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pt-6"><button type="button" disabled={page===1} onClick={()=>patch({page:String(page-1)})} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-40"><ArrowLeft size={16}/>{' '}<Tr text={"Previous"}/></button><span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Page')} {page} {t('of')} {Math.ceil(total/12)}</span><button type="button" disabled={page>=Math.ceil(total/12)} onClick={()=>patch({page:String(page+1)})} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-40"><Tr text={"Next"}/>{' '}<ArrowRight size={16}/></button></div>}
    </div>
  </div>
 </main><StoreFooter/></div>

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, CreditCard, Lock, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import StoreHeader, { StoreFooter } from '../components/StoreHeader';
import { TOKEN_KEY, useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { getCart, type CartLine } from '../services/cart';
import { formatVND } from '../services/catalog';
import { checkoutOrder } from '../services/orders';
import { logInteraction } from '../services/faas';

type BuyNowItem = {
  product_id: string;
  product_name: string;
  image_url?: string | null;
  unit_price: number;
  quantity: number;
  stock_quantity: number;
};

type CheckoutLocationState = {
  buyNowItem?: BuyNowItem;
} | null;

export default function Checkout() {
  const { t } = usePreferences();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const buyNowItem = (location.state as CheckoutLocationState)?.buyNowItem;

  const [items, setItems] = useState<CartLine[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState(user?.username || '');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [address, setAddress] = useState('');
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState<'card' | 'e_wallet' | 'cod'>('card');
  const [simulateFailure, setSimulateFailure] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    if (buyNowItem) {
      setItems([
        {
          product_id: buyNowItem.product_id,
          product_name: buyNowItem.product_name,
          image_url: buyNowItem.image_url,
          unit_price: buyNowItem.unit_price,
          quantity: buyNowItem.quantity,
          subtotal: buyNowItem.unit_price * buyNowItem.quantity,
          stock_quantity: buyNowItem.stock_quantity,
        },
      ]);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    let ignore = false;
    getCart(user.id)
      .then((cart) => {
        if (!ignore) setItems(cart.items);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!ignore) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to load order items.');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!ignore) setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, [user, buyNowItem]);

  const totalAmount = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.subtotal, 0);
  const totalQuantity = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!user || !items.length) return;

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError('');

    for (const item of items) {
      void logInteraction({ userId: user.id, productId: item.product_id, action: 'checkout' });
    }

    try {
      const token = sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
      const order = await checkoutOrder(token, user.id, {
        ...(buyNowItem
          ? { items: [{ product_id: buyNowItem.product_id, quantity: buyNowItem.quantity }] }
          : {}),
        simulate_failure: simulateFailure,
      });

      for (const item of items) {
        void logInteraction({
          userId: user.id,
          productId: item.product_id,
          action: 'purchase',
          value: 5.0,
        });
      }

      navigate(`/profile/purchases/${order.id}`, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Checkout failed.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#faf9f6] dark:bg-[#0b1322] dark:text-slate-100">
      <StoreHeader />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <Link to="/cart" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600">
          <ArrowLeft size={14} /><Tr text={'Back to shopping bag'}/></Link>

        <p className="mt-6 text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[.22em] text-indigo-600"><Tr text={'Secure checkout'}/></p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-['Georgia',serif] text-[40px] tracking-[-.05em] sm:text-[52px]"><Tr text={'Complete your order.'}/></h1>

        {error && (
          <div className="mt-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300" role="alert">
            <AlertTriangle size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>{t(error)}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="my-10 h-64 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900" />
        ) : items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="my-10 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-12 text-center">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold"><Tr text={'Nothing to check out'}/></h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'Add an instrument to your bag first.'}/></p>
            <Link
              to="/shop"
              className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#263247] px-7 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white"
            ><Tr text={'Browse instruments'}/></Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="mt-9 grid items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">
            <section className="space-y-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 sm:p-8">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#242b37] dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={'Shipping details'}/></h2>
                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"><Tr text={'Full name'}/></label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={fullName}
                      onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"><Tr text={'Phone number'}/></label>
                    <input
                      type="tel"
                      required
                      value={phone}
                      onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="09xx xxx xxx"
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-4">
                  <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"><Tr text={'Delivery address'}/></label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={address}
                    onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={t("Street, ward, district, city")}
                    className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <p className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"><Tr text="Delivery and payment fields are for the checkout interface; the current order API does not save these details or charge a payment method."/></p>

              <div className="border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-6">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#242b37] dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={'Payment method'}/></h2>
                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
                  {[
                    { id: 'card', label: 'Credit / Debit Card' },
                    { id: 'e_wallet', label: 'E-Wallet' },
                    { id: 'cod', label: 'Cash on Delivery' },
                  ].map((opt) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={opt.id}
                      onClick={() => setPaymentMethod(opt.id as typeof paymentMethod)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-3 text-xs font-bold transition ${
                        paymentMethod === opt.id
                          ? 'border-[#263247] bg-[#263247] text-white'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <CreditCard size={14} />
                      {t(opt.label)}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_ENABLE_FAILURE_TEST === 'true' && <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/30 p-4">
                <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={simulateFailure}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimulateFailure(e.target.checked)}
                    className="mt-0.5"
                  />
                  <span>
                    <strong><Tr text="Demo mode: Simulate payment failure"/></strong> (sends <code>simulate_failure: true</code> to
                    verify PostgreSQL pessimistic lock &amp; automatic inventory ROLLBACK)
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>}
            </section>

            <aside className="rounded-2xl border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-7">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold"><Tr text={'Order summary'}/></h2>
              <ul className="mt-5 divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.product_id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 text-sm">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{item.product_name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{t("Qty")}: {item.quantity}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="shrink-0 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{formatVND(item.subtotal)}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

              <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-4 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <span>{t("Items")} ({totalQuantity})</span>
                  <span>{formatVND(totalAmount)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <span>{t("Shipping")}</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600"><Tr text={'Free'}/></span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
                  <span className="font-bold"><Tr text={'Total'}/></span>
                  <span className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{formatVND(totalAmount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="mt-6 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#263247] px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-indigo-600 disabled:bg-slate-300"
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  t('Processing transaction...')
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Lock size={15} /> {t("Place order")} {formatVND(totalAmount)}
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

              <p className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <ShieldCheck size={14} className="text-emerald-600" /><Tr text={'Stock is checked when the order is placed.'}/></p>
              {simulateFailure && (
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-700">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} /><Tr text={'Will trigger rollback test on submit'}/></p>
              )}
            </aside>
          </form>
        )}
      </main>
      <StoreFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { BackLink, FormField } from '../components/UI';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { DEMO_MODE } from '../services/auth';

export default function EditProfile() {
 const {t}=usePreferences();
  const { user, updateProfile } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [username,setUsername] = useState(user?.username || '');
  const [email,setEmail] = useState(user?.email || '');
  const [error,setError] = useState('');
  if (!user) return null;
  const canEdit = DEMO_MODE && user.id !== 'DEMO_001';
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault(); setError('');
    if (!canEdit) return;
    try { updateProfile({ username: username.trim(), email: email.trim().toLowerCase() }); navigate('/profile'); }
    catch(e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to update profile.'); }
  }
  return <><div><BackLink/><h1 className="mt-4 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={"Edit profile"}/></h1><p className="mt-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Update your account details."}/></p></div>
    {!canEdit && <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t(DEMO_MODE ? 'This shared preview account is read-only.' : 'Profile changes are not yet supported by the account service.')}</p>}
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8"><h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={"Basic information"}/></h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"These fields are supported by the current user database."}/></p>
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-7 max-w-xl space-y-6"><FormField label="Username" id="edit-username" required minLength={3} maxLength={50} disabled={!canEdit} autoComplete="username" value={username} onChange={e=>setUsername(e.target.value)}/><FormField label="Email address" id="edit-email" required type="email" maxLength={100} disabled={!canEdit} autoComplete="email" value={email} onChange={e=>setEmail(e.target.value)}/><div><label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"><Tr text={"User ID"}/></label><div className="input-base bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400">{user.id}</div><p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Your unique identifier cannot be changed."}/></p></div>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">{t(error)}</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-6"><button className="primary-button" disabled={!canEdit} type="submit"><Save size={18}/>{' '}<Tr text={"Save changes"}/></button><button className="secondary-button" type="button" onClick={()=>navigate('/profile')}><Tr text={"Cancel"}/></button></div>
      </form>
    </section></>;
}

      </div>
    </div>
   </section>

   <section className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1280px] gap-5 px-5 py-8 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:px-8 sm:py-10">
     <div className="flex items-start gap-3"><div className="mt-0.5 rounded-xl bg-[#edebf5] dark:bg-indigo-500/10 p-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"><SlidersHorizontal size={19}/></div><div><h2 className="text-sm font-bold"><Tr text={"Explore with confidence"}/></h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Browse by instrument and find the right fit."}/></p></div></div>
     <div className="flex items-start gap-3"><div className="mt-0.5 rounded-xl bg-[#edebf5] dark:bg-indigo-500/10 p-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"><Music2 size={19}/></div><div><h2 className="text-sm font-bold"><Tr text={"For every stage"}/></h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"From practice rooms to performance spaces."}/></p></div></div>
     <div className="flex items-start gap-3"><div className="mt-0.5 rounded-xl bg-[#edebf5] dark:bg-indigo-500/10 p-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"><Sparkles size={19}/></div><div><h2 className="text-sm font-bold"><Tr text={"Made personal"}/></h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Discover recommendations as you explore."}/></p></div></div>
   </section>

import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
const symbols={order:PackageCheck,account:ShieldCheck,offer:Gift};
export default function Notifications(){
 const {t,date}=usePreferences();
 const location = useLocation();
 const {user}=useAuth(); const id=user?.id||'guest';const [filter,setFilter]=useState<'all'|'unread'>('all');const [version,setVersion]=useState(0);const data=notices(); const unread=data.filter(n=>!isNoticeRead(n,id)).length;const shown=data.filter(n=>filter==='all'||!isNoticeRead(n,id));
 const markAll=()=>{markNoticeRead(data.map(n=>n.id),id);setVersion(version+1)};
 return <div className="space-y-6"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4"><div><p className="eyebrow"><Tr text={"ACCOUNT UPDATES"}/></p><h1 className="page-title"><Tr text={"Notifications"}/></h1><p className="page-subtitle"><Tr text={"Your messages, updates and order activity in one place."}/></p></div>{unread>0&&<button className="secondary-button" onClick={markAll}><CheckCheck size={17}/>{' '}<Tr text={"Mark all read"}/></button>}</div>
 <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><div className="panel flex items-center gap-4 p-5"><span className="rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 p-3 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"><Bell/></span><div><p className="text-2xl font-extrabold">{data.length}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Total notifications"}/></p></div></div><div className="panel flex items-center gap-4 p-5"><span className="rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 p-3 text-amber-600"><Clock3/></span><div><p className="text-2xl font-extrabold">{unread}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Unread notifications"}/></p></div></div></div>
 <section className="panel overflow-hidden"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 p-5"><h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={"Your inbox"}/></h2><div className="flex gap-2">{(['all','unread'] as const).map(f=><button key={f} className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold ${filter===f?'bg-indigo-600 text-white':'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300'}`} onClick={()=>setFilter(f)}>{t(f==='all'?'All':'Unread')}</button>)}</div></div>

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, CreditCard, MapPin, Package, ReceiptText, RefreshCcw, Truck, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { BackLink } from '../components/UI';
import { useAuth, TOKEN_KEY } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { getOrders, formatMoney, type Order } from '../services/orders';
const stages=['CONFIRMED','PROCESSING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED'];
function stageIndex(status:string){const index=stages.indexOf(status.toUpperCase());return index>=0?index:-1}
export default function OrderDetail(){
 const {t,date}=usePreferences();const {orderId}=useParams();const {user}=useAuth();const [order,setOrder]=useState<Order|null>(null);const [loading,setLoading]=useState(true);const [error,setError]=useState('');const [retry,setRetry]=useState(0);
 useEffect(()=>{const token=sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);if(!user||!token){setLoading(false);return}let active=true;setLoading(true);setError('');getOrders(token,user.id).then(orders=>{if(!active)return;setOrder(orders.find(o=>String(o.id)===orderId)||null)}).catch(e=>{if(active)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'Unable to load order')}).finally(()=>{if(active)setLoading(false)});return()=>{active=false}},[user?.id,orderId,retry]);
 if(loading)return <div className="panel p-10 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Loading order…"}/></div>;
 if(error)return <div className="panel p-9"><BackLink to="/profile/purchases" label="Back to purchases"/><div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-3 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300"><AlertCircle/>{t(error)}</div><button onClick={()=>setRetry(x=>x+1)} className="secondary-button mt-6"><RefreshCcw size={16}/>{' '}<Tr text={"Retry"}/></button></div>;
 if(!order)return <div className="panel p-9"><BackLink to="/profile/purchases" label="Back to purchases"/><h1 className="mt-6 text-2xl font-bold"><Tr text={"Order not found"}/></h1><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"This order is not present in your account's order history."}/></p></div>;
 const status=order.status.toUpperCase();const progress=stageIndex(status);const canceled=['CANCELLED','CANCELED'].includes(status);const itemSum=order.items.reduce((acc,item)=>acc+item.subtotal,0);return <div className="space-y-6"><BackLink to="/profile/purchases" label="Back to my purchases"/><div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4"><div><p className="eyebrow"><Tr text={"ORDER DETAILS"}/></p><h1 className="page-title">{t('Order')} #{order.id}</h1><p className="page-subtitle">{t('Placed')} {date(order.created_at)} · {order.items.length} {t('products')}</p></div><span className={`rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-extrabold tracking-wider ${canceled?'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300':progress===3?'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300':'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300'}`}>{t(status)}</span></div>
 <section className="panel overflow-hidden"><div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 p-6"><Truck size={21} className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"/><h2 className="text-lg font-bold"><Tr text={"Order progress"}/></h2></div><div className="p-6 sm:p-8">{progress>=0?<div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-4">{stages.map((step,index)=><div key={step} className="flex items-start gap-3 sm:flex-col"><span className={`flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${index<=progress?'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300':'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>{index<=progress?<CheckCircle2 size={21}/>:<span className="font-bold">{index+1}</span>}</span><div><p className={`text-sm font-bold ${index<=progress?'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200':'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>{t(step)}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400">{t(index===progress?'Current recorded status':index<progress?'Completed stage':'Awaiting update')}</p></div></div>)}</div>:<div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 p-4 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"><Tr text={"Current backend status:"}/>{' '}<strong>{t(order.status)}</strong>. <Tr text="No shipment milestones are available for this status."/></div>}<p className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"This represents your current order status; shipment scans and timestamps are not available."}/></p></div></section>
 <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2"><section className="panel p-6"><h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-bold"><MapPin size={19} className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"/>{' '}<Tr text={"Delivery address"}/></h2><div className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 p-5"><p className="font-semibold"><Tr text={"Not available"}/></p><p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Delivery address details are not available for this order."}/></p></div></section><section className="panel p-6"><h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-bold"><Truck size={19} className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"/>{' '}<Tr text={"Shipping details"}/></h2><div className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 p-5"><p className="font-semibold"><Tr text={"Carrier / tracking number unavailable"}/></p><p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"No carrier tracking details are available for this order."}/></p></div></section></div>

FILE: frontend/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, ChevronRight, Minus, Plus, ShoppingBag, Sparkles, Star, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import StoreHeader, { StoreFooter } from '../components/StoreHeader';
import ProductCard from '../components/ProductCard';
import {
  formatVND,
  getFrequentlyBoughtTogether,
  getProduct,
  productImage,
  productImageCandidates,
  type Product,
  type RecommendationMeta,
} from '../services/catalog';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { addToCart } from '../services/cart';
import { logInteraction } from '../services/faas';

export default function ProductDetails() {
  const { t } = usePreferences();
  const { productId } = useParams();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const [product, setProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [added, setAdded] = useState(false);
  const [image, setImage] = useState('');

  const [related, setRelated] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [recsMeta, setRecsMeta] = useState<RecommendationMeta | null>(null);
  const [recsLoading, setRecsLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!productId) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setAdded(false);
    setQty(1);

    getProduct(productId)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setProduct(p);
        setImage(productImage(p, "detail"));
        void logInteraction({ userId: user?.id, productId: p.id, action: 'view' });
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to load product.');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });

    setRecsLoading(true);
    getFrequentlyBoughtTogether(productId, 4)
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setRelated(res.items);
        setRecsMeta(res.meta);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setRelated([]);
          setRecsMeta(null);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setRecsLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [productId, user?.id]);

  async function onAdd() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate(`/signin?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname)}`);
      return;
    }
    if (!product) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      await addToCart(user.id, product.id, qty);
      setAdded(true);
      void logInteraction({ userId: user.id, productId: product.id, action: 'add_to_cart' });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to add to bag.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function onBuyNow() {
    if (!product) return;
    if (!user) {
      navigate(`/signin?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname)}`);
      return;
    }
    void logInteraction({ userId: user.id, productId: product.id, action: 'click' });
    navigate('/checkout', {
      state: {
        buyNowItem: {
          product_id: product.id,
          product_name: product.name,
          image_url: productImage(product, "detail"),
          unit_price: product.price,
          quantity: qty,
          stock_quantity: product.stock_quantity,
        },
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#faf9f6] dark:bg-[#0b1322] dark:text-slate-100">
      <StoreHeader />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-5 pb-16 pt-8 sm:px-8">
        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">
          <Link to="/" className="hover:text-indigo-600"><Tr text={'Home'}/></Link>
          <ChevronRight size={13} />
          <Link to="/shop" className="hover:text-indigo-600"><Tr text={'Instruments'}/></Link>
          <ChevronRight size={13} />
          <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"><Tr text={'Product details'}/></span>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="aspect-square animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700" />
            <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800" />
          </div>
        ) : error && !product ? (
          <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-12 text-center">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold"><Tr text={'Product unavailable'}/></h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{error || 'We could not find this instrument.'}</p>
            <Link to="/shop" className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-indigo-600">
              <ArrowLeft size={17} /><Tr text={'Back to collection'}/></Link>
          </div>
        ) : product ? (
          <>
            <div className="grid items-start gap-10 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16">
              <div>
                <div className="aspect-[1.1] overflow-hidden rounded-[26px] bg-[#ebe8e1] dark:bg-slate-800">
                  <img
                    src={image}
                    alt={product.name}
                    className="h-full w-full object-contain p-5 sm:p-8"
                    decoding="async"
                    onError={() => {
                      if (!product) return;
                      const sources = productImageCandidates(product, 'detail');
                      const currentIndex = sources.indexOf(image);
                      const next = sources[currentIndex + 1];
                      if (next) setImage(next);
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                {product.large_urls && product.large_urls.length > 1 && (
                  <div className="mt-4 flex gap-3">
                    {product.large_urls.slice(0, 4).map((url) => (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        key={url}
                        onClick={() => setImage(url)}
                        className={`h-20 w-20 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 ${
                          image === url ? 'border-indigo-600 ring-2 ring-indigo-600/20' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <img src={url} alt={t("Product alternate view")} className="h-full w-full object-contain p-1" />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="py-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[.2em] text-indigo-600">
                  {t(product.category || 'Instrument')}
                </p>
                <h1 className="mt-4 font-['Georgia',serif] text-[38px] leading-[1.1] tracking-[-.04em] text-[#242b37] dark:text-slate-100 sm:text-[54px]">
                  {product.name}
                </h1>
                <div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#ad8b3e]">
                  {product.rating != null && (
                    <>
                      <Star size={16} fill="currentColor" />
                      <span className="font-bold">{product.rating.toFixed(1)}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400">({product.rating_count || 0} {t("reviews")})</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>

                <p className="mt-7 text-[31px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                  {formatVND(product.price)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-5 max-w-lg text-[15px] leading-8 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {t(product.description || 'Explore the details of this instrument, and discover the sound that works for you.')}
                </p>

                <div className="mt-8 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${product.stock_quantity > 0 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-400'}`} />
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {product.stock_quantity > 0 ? `${product.stock_quantity} {t("available")}` : 'Out of stock'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-4 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label={t("Decrease quantity")}
                      disabled={qty <= 1}
                      onClick={() => setQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}
                      className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                      <Minus size={17} />
                    </button>
                    <span className="w-5 text-center text-sm font-bold">{qty}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label={t("Increase quantity")}
                      disabled={qty >= product.stock_quantity}
                      onClick={() => setQty((q) => Math.min(product.stock_quantity, q + 1))}
                      className="grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                      <Plus size={17} />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy || product.stock_quantity <= 0}
                    onClick={onAdd}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full bg-[#263247] px-7 py-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-indigo-600 disabled:bg-slate-300"
                  >
                    {added ? (
                      <>
                        <Check size={18} /><Tr text={'Added to bag'}/></>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <ShoppingBag size={18} /> {t(busy ? 'Adding...' : 'Add to bag')}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy || product.stock_quantity <= 0}
                    onClick={onBuyNow}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#263247] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-6 py-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#263247] dark:text-slate-100 transition hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:border-slate-200 disabled:text-slate-300"
                  >
                    <Zap size={16} /><Tr text={'Buy now'}/></button>
                </div>

                {added && (
                  <Link to="/cart" className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600"><Tr text={'View your bag'}/><ArrowRight size={16} />
                  </Link>
                )}

                {error && (
                  <p role="alert" className="mt-5 text-sm text-red-600">
                    {t(error)}
                  </p>
                )}

                <div className="mt-11 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pt-7">
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold"><Tr text={'Product information'}/></h2>
                  <dl className="mt-4 grid gap-3 text-sm">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <dt className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'Category'}/></dt>
                      <dd className="font-semibold">{product.category || 'Not specified'}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <dt className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'Product ID'}/></dt>
                      <dd className="font-mono text-xs">{product.id}</dd>
                    </div>
                  </dl>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <section className="mt-20 border-t border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 pt-14">
              <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[.2em] text-indigo-600">
                    <Sparkles size={13} /><Tr text={'Cloud Recommender'}/></p>
                  <h2 className="mt-2 font-['Georgia',serif] text-3xl tracking-[-.03em] text-[#242b37] dark:text-slate-100"><Tr text={'Frequently bought together'}/></h2>
                </div>
                {recsMeta && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {recsMeta.data_source && (
                      <span className="rounded-full border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1">
                        {t("Source")}: <strong>{recsMeta.data_source}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {recsMeta.deployment_slot && (
                      <span className="rounded-full border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1">
                        Slot: <strong className="uppercase">{recsMeta.deployment_slot}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {recsMeta.latency_ms != null && (
                      <span className="rounded-full border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-3 py-1">
                        {t("Latency")}: <strong>{recsMeta.latency_ms.toFixed(1)} ms</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {recsLoading ? (
                <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
                  {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
                    <div key={n} className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900" />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : related.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
                  {related.map((item) => (
                    <ProductCard key={item.id} product={item} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="rounded-2xl border border-[#eeebe5] dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={'No complementary recommendations found for this instrument yet.'}/></p>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </main>
      <StoreFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Archive, ArrowRight, Box, CalendarDays, CircleCheck, Clock3, Package, RefreshCcw, Search, ShoppingBag, Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth, TOKEN_KEY } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { getOrders, formatMoney, type Order } from '../services/orders';
import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

type Filter = 'all' | 'ongoing' | 'completed';
const completed = (status: string) => ['DELIVERED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CANCELED'].includes(status.toUpperCase());
function Status({status}:{status:string}) {
  const {t}=usePreferences();
  const done = ['DELIVERED','COMPLETED'].includes(status.toUpperCase());
  const cancelled = ['CANCELLED','CANCELED'].includes(status.toUpperCase());
  return <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${cancelled?'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300':done?'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300':'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'}`}>{done?<CircleCheck size={13}/>:cancelled?<Archive size={13}/>:<Clock3 size={13}/>} {t(status.toUpperCase())}</span>;
}
export default function Purchases() {
 const {t,date}=usePreferences();
 const location = useLocation();
 const {user} = useAuth(); const [orders,setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]); const [loading,setLoading] = useState(true); const [error,setError] = useState(''); const [filter,setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all'); const [search,setSearch] = useState(''); const [retry,setRetry]=useState(0);
 useEffect(()=>{ const token=sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY); if(!token||!user){setLoading(false);return;} let alive=true; setLoading(true);setError(''); getOrders(token,user.id).then(data=>{if(alive)setOrders(data)}).catch(e=>{if(alive)setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'Could not load orders')}).finally(()=>{if(alive)setLoading(false)});return ()=>{alive=false}},[user?.id,retry]);
 const visible=useMemo(()=>orders.filter(o=>(filter==='all'||(filter==='completed'?completed(o.status):!completed(o.status)))&&(`${o.id} ${o.items.map(x=>x.product_name).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))),[orders,filter,search]);

 </section></div>
}
function Metric({icon,value,label}:{icon:React.ReactNode;value:number;label:string}){const {t}=usePreferences();return <div className="panel flex items-center gap-4 p-5"><div className="rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 p-3 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">{icon}</div><div><p className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{value}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t(label)}</p></div></div>}

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Eye, EyeOff, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { AuthLayout, FormField } from '../components/UI';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function SignIn() {
 const {t}=usePreferences();
  const { user, login } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const requested = searchParams.get('next');
  const returnTo = requested && requested.startsWith('/') && !requested.startsWith('//') ? requested : '/profile';
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  if (user) return <Navigate to="/profile" replace/>;
  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault(); setError(''); setBusy(true);
    try { await login({ username: username.trim(), password }); navigate(returnTo, { replace: true }); }
    catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to sign in.'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return <AuthLayout heading="Welcome back" subheading="Sign in to your account to continue your journey.">
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
      <FormField id="username" label="Username or email" autoComplete="username" placeholder="Enter your username or email" required value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}/>
      <div><div className="relative"><FormField id="password" label="Password" autoComplete="current-password" placeholder="Enter your password" type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'} required value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}/><button type="button" className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" aria-label={t(visible ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password')} onClick={() => setVisible(!visible)}>{visible ? <EyeOff size={19}/> : <Eye size={19}/>}</button></div></div>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">{t(error)}</p>}
      <button className="primary-button w-full" disabled={busy} type="submit">{t(busy ? 'Signing in…' : 'Sign in')}<ArrowRight size={18}/></button>
    </form>
    <p className="mt-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Don't have an account?"}/>{' '}<Link className="font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline" to="/signup"><Tr text={"Create an account"}/></Link></p>
  </AuthLayout>;
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx

import { Tr, usePreferences } from '../context/PreferencesContext';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { AuthLayout, FormField } from '../components/UI';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function SignUp() {
 const {t}=usePreferences();
  const { user, register } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ username: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '' });
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  if (user) return <Navigate to="/profile" replace/>;
  const change = (key: keyof typeof values, value: string) => setValues(v => ({ ...v, [key]: value }));
  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault(); setError('');
    if (values.username.trim().length < 3) { setError('Username must be at least 3 characters.'); return; }
    if (!/^(?=.*[0-9])(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9\s]).{8,}$/.test(values.password)) { setError('Password requires at least 8 characters, one number, and one special character.'); return; }
    if (values.password !== values.confirm) { setError('Passwords do not match.'); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    try { await register({ username: values.username.trim(), email: values.email.trim(), password: values.password }); navigate('/profile', { replace: true }); }
    catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to register.'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return <AuthLayout heading="Create an account" subheading="Join Soundwave and discover gear made for you.">
    <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={submit}>
      <FormField id="username" label="Username" placeholder="Choose a username" autoComplete="username" minLength={3} maxLength={50} required value={values.username} onChange={e => change('username', e.target.value)}/>
      <FormField id="email" label="Email address" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" autoComplete="email" maxLength={100} required value={values.email} onChange={e => change('email', e.target.value)}/>
      <div className="relative"><FormField id="password" label="Password" type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'} placeholder="8+ characters, number & symbol" autoComplete="new-password" minLength={8} maxLength={128} required value={values.password} onChange={e => change('password', e.target.value)}/><button type="button" aria-label={t(visible ? 'Hide passwords' : 'Show passwords')} className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" onClick={() => setVisible(!visible)}>{visible ? <EyeOff size={19}/> : <Eye size={19}/>}</button></div>
      <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3" aria-label={t("Password requirements")}>{([['8+ characters',values.password.length>=8],['One number',/[0-9]/.test(values.password)],['Special character',/[^A-Za-z0-9\s]/.test(values.password)]] as const).map(([label,ok])=><span key={label} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${ok?'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300':'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>{ok?<Check size={14}/>:<X size={14}/>} {t(label)}</span>)}</div>
      <FormField id="confirm" label="Confirm password" type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'} placeholder="Re-enter your password" autoComplete="new-password" minLength={8} required value={values.confirm} onChange={e => change('confirm', e.target.value)}/>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">{t(error)}</p>}
      <button className="primary-button w-full" disabled={busy} type="submit">{t(busy ? 'Creating account…' : 'Create account')}<ArrowRight size={18}/></button>
    </form>
    <p className="mt-7 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><Tr text={"Already have an account?"}/>{' '}<Link to="/signin" className="font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline"><Tr text={"Sign in"}/></Link></p>
  </AuthLayout>;
}

FILE: frontend/src/services/auth.ts

import type { AuthResponse, Credentials, Registration, User } from '../types';

export const DEMO_MODE = import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_DEMO_MODE === 'true';
const API_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_AUTH_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
const DEMO_USERS_KEY = 'ecommerce-demo-users';
const demoSeed: User = { id: 'DEMO_001', username: 'alexmusic', email: 'alex@example.com', role: 'customer', created_at: '2026-01-15T09:30:00Z' };

type DemoAccount = { user: User; password: string };
function readAccounts(): DemoAccount[] {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DEMO_USERS_KEY) || '[]') as DemoAccount[];
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}
function demoAccounts(): DemoAccount[] {
  return [{ user: demoSeed, password: 'Demo123!' }, ...readAccounts()];
}
function fakeToken(user: User): AuthResponse {
  return { access_token: `demo-token-${user.id}`, token_type: 'bearer', expires_in: 86400, user };
}
async function request<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...init.headers },
    });
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Cannot reach the authentication service. Check VITE_AUTH_API_URL and whether the backend is running.');
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const details = typeof body.detail === 'string' ? body.detail : `Request failed (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(details);
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}
export async function signIn(credentials: Credentials): Promise<AuthResponse> {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) return request('/api/v1/auth/login', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(credentials) });
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
  const found = demoAccounts().find(a =>
    (a.user.username.toLowerCase() === credentials.username.trim().toLowerCase() || a.user.email.toLowerCase() === credentials.username.trim().toLowerCase()) && a.password === credentials.password
  );
  if (!found) throw new Error('Invalid username/email or password. Try the demo account.');
  return fakeToken(found.user);
}
export async function signUp(data: Registration): Promise<AuthResponse> {
  if (!/^(?=.*[0-9])(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9\s]).{8,}$/.test(data.password)) throw new Error('Password must have at least 8 characters, one number, and one special character.');
  if (!DEMO_MODE) return request('/api/v1/auth/register', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ username: data.username, email: data.email, password: data.password }) });
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
  const accounts = demoAccounts();
  if (accounts.some(a => a.user.username.toLowerCase() === data.username.trim().toLowerCase() || a.user.email.toLowerCase() === data.email.trim().toLowerCase())) {
    throw new Error('Username or email already exists.');
  }
  const user: User = { id: `DEMO_${Date.now()}`, username: data.username.trim(), email: data.email.trim().toLowerCase(), role: 'customer', created_at: new Date().toISOString() };
  localStorage.setItem(DEMO_USERS_KEY, JSON.stringify([...readAccounts(), { user, password: data.password }]));
  return fakeToken(user);
}
export async function getMe(token: string): Promise<User> {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) return request('/api/v1/auth/me', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  const id = token.replace(/^demo-token-/, '');
  const found = demoAccounts().find(a => a.user.id === id);
  if (!found) throw new Error('Session expired. Please sign in again.');
  return found.user;
}
export function updateDemoUser(id: string, changes: Pick<User, 'username'|'email'>): User {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) throw new Error('The backend does not provide a profile-update endpoint yet.');
  const accounts = readAccounts();
  if (id === demoSeed.id) throw new Error('The shared demo account cannot be modified. Sign up for a new demo account to test editing.');
  if (demoAccounts().some(a => a.user.id !== id && (a.user.username.toLowerCase() === changes.username.toLowerCase() || a.user.email.toLowerCase() === changes.email.toLowerCase()))) {
    throw new Error('Username or email already exists.');
  }
  const index = accounts.findIndex(a => a.user.id === id);
  if (index < 0) throw new Error('Demo account not found.');
  accounts[index].user = { ...accounts[index].user, ...changes };
  localStorage.setItem(DEMO_USERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(accounts));
  return accounts[index].user;
}

FILE: frontend/src/services/cart.ts
==========================================
import { TOKEN_KEY } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { DEMO_MODE } from './auth';
import { demoProducts, type Product } from './catalog';

export type CartLine = {
  product_id: string;
  product_name: string;
  image_url?: string | null;
  thumb_url?: string | null;
  unit_price: number;
  quantity: number;
  subtotal: number;
  stock_quantity: number;
};

export type Cart = {
  total_amount: number;
  total_quantity: number;
  items: CartLine[];
};

const API = (import.meta.env.VITE_ORDER_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
const key = (userId: string) => `soundwave-demo-cart-${userId}`;

function demoRead(userId: string): Record<string, number> {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key(userId)) || '{}') as Record<string, number>;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function demoSave(userId: string, items: Record<string, number>) {
  localStorage.setItem(key(userId), JSON.stringify(items));
}

function demoCart(userId: string): Cart {
  const lines = Object.entries(demoRead(userId)).flatMap(([id, quantity]) => {
    const product: Product | undefined = demoProducts.find((p) => p.id === id);
    return product && quantity > 0
      ? [
          {
            product_id: id,
            product_name: product.name,
            image_url: product.image_url,
            unit_price: product.price,
            quantity,
            subtotal: product.price * quantity,
            stock_quantity: product.stock_quantity,
          },
        ]
      : [];
  });
  return {
    items: lines,
    total_quantity: lines.reduce((s, p) => s + p.quantity, 0),
    total_amount: lines.reduce((s, p) => s + p.subtotal, 0),
  };
}

async function cartRequest(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}) {
  const token = sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  if (!token) throw new Error('Please sign in to manage your cart.');
  const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...init.headers,
    },
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(typeof body.detail === 'string' ? body.detail : `Cart request failed (${response.status}).`);
  }
  const data = (await response.json()) as Cart;
  if (init.method && init.method !== 'GET') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('soundwave-cart-update'));
  }
  return data;
}

export async function getCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
  return DEMO_MODE ? demoCart(userId) : cartRequest('/api/v1/cart');
}

export async function addToCart(userId: string, id: string, quantity = 1): Promise<Cart> {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) {
    return cartRequest('/api/v1/cart/items', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: id, quantity }),
    });
  }
  const data = demoRead(userId);
  const product = demoProducts.find((p) => p.id === id);
  if (!product) throw new Error('Product not found.');
  if ((data[id] || 0) + quantity > product.stock_quantity) throw new Error('Not enough stock available.');
  data[id] = (data[id] || 0) + quantity;
  demoSave(userId, data);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('soundwave-cart-update'));
  return demoCart(userId);
}

export async function setCartQuantity(userId: string, id: string, quantity: number): Promise<Cart> {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) {
    if (quantity <= 0) {
      return cartRequest(`/api/v1/cart/items/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    }
    return cartRequest(`/api/v1/cart/items/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ quantity }),
    });
  }
  const data = demoRead(userId);
  const p = demoProducts.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (p && quantity > p.stock_quantity) throw new Error('Not enough stock available.');
  if (quantity <= 0) delete data[id];
  else data[id] = quantity;
  demoSave(userId, data);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('soundwave-cart-update'));
  return demoCart(userId);
}

export async function clearCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
  if (!DEMO_MODE) return cartRequest('/api/v1/cart', { method: 'DELETE' });
  demoSave(userId, {});
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('soundwave-cart-update'));
  return { items: [], total_quantity: 0, total_amount: 0 };
}
