@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """Đảm bảo các bảng dữ liệu (products, cart_items, orders, order_items, reviews) đã sẵn sàng."""
    try:
        Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
        logger.info("Đã kết nối PostgreSQL và xác nhận các bảng Order/Cart sẵn sàng.")
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(f"Không thể tự động khởi tạo bảng khi startup: {exc}")
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title="E-Commerce Order, Cart & Product Service API",
    description=(
        "Microservice quản lý Danh mục Sản phẩm, Giỏ hàng, Đặt hàng và Khóa bi quan tồn kho "
        "(Pessimistic Concurrency Control - Port 8002)."
    ),
    version="1.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
# Nén payload JSON trả về bằng Gzip
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=500)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GIAO TIẾP NỘI BỘ GIỮA 2 MICROSERVICES (ORDER SERVICE -> AUTH SERVICE)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def verify_authenticated_user(
    authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id"),
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Xác thực danh tính người dùng bằng cách gọi HTTP nội bộ sang `Auth Service`:
    `GET http://auth-service:8001/api/v1/auth/verify-token`
    """
    if authorization and authorization.lower().startswith("bearer "):
        token = authorization.split(" ", 1)[1].strip()
        verify_url = f"{AUTH_SERVICE_URL.rstrip('/')}/api/v1/auth/verify-token"
        try:
            with httpx.Client(timeout=3.0) as client:
                resp = client.get(
                    verify_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
                )
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                data = resp.json()
                if data.get("valid") and data.get("user_id"):
                    return data
            elif resp.status_code in (401, 403):
                try:
                    err_detail = resp.json().get(
                        "detail", "Token không hợp lệ từ Auth Service."
                    )
                except ValueError:
                    err_detail = "Token không hợp lệ từ Auth Service."
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                    detail=err_detail,
                )
        except HTTPException:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug(
                f"Không kết nối được Auth Service tại {verify_url} ({exc}), fallback giải mã JWT cục bộ."
            )

        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM])
            return {
                "valid": True,
                "user_id": payload.get("user_id") or payload.get("sub"),
                "username": payload.get("username"),
                "role": payload.get("role", "customer"),
            }
        except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail=f"Token không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn: {str(exc)}",
            )

    if x_user_id and x_user_id.strip():
        return {
            "valid": True,
            "user_id": x_user_id.strip(),
            "username": x_user_id.strip(),
            "role": "customer",
        }

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Yêu cầu đăng nhập (Thiếu Header Authorization: Bearer <token>).",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )

@app.get("/health", tags=["Health"])
def health_check(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    try:
        product_count = (
            db.query(func.count(Product.id))
            .filter(Product.is_active.is_(True))
            .scalar()
            or 0
        )
        db_status = "connected"
    except Exception as exc:
        product_count = 0
        db_status = f"error: {str(exc)}"

    return {
        "service": "order_service",
        "status": "healthy" if db_status == "connected" else "degraded",
        "port": 8002,
        "database": db_status,
        "total_products": product_count,
        "auth_service_url": AUTH_SERVICE_URL,
    }

# 1. API DANH MỤC SẢN PHẨM (PRODUCTS CATALOG)

@app.get(
    "/api/v1/products",
    response_model=PaginatedProductResponse,
    tags=["Products Catalog"],
)
def list_products(
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1, description="Số trang (bắt đầu từ 1)"),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Số sản phẩm mỗi trang"),
    category: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Lọc theo danh mục"),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Từ khóa tìm kiếm tên/mô tả"),
    sort_by: str = Query(
        default="default",
        pattern="^(default|price_asc|price_desc|name_asc)$",
        description="Sắp xếp: default | price_asc | price_desc | name_asc",
    ),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Lấy danh sách sản phẩm nhạc cụ đang mở bán (`is_active = TRUE`)."""
    query = db.query(Product).filter(Product.is_active.is_(True))

    if category and category.strip() and category.lower() != "all":
        query = query.filter(Product.category.ilike(f"%{category.strip()}%"))

    if search and search.strip():
        kw = f"%{search.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Product.name.ilike(kw),
                Product.description.ilike(kw),
                Product.category.ilike(kw),
                Product.id.ilike(kw),
            )
        )

    total = query.count()

    if sort_by == "price_asc":
        query = query.order_by(Product.price.asc())
    elif sort_by == "price_desc":
        query = query.order_by(Product.price.desc())
    elif sort_by == "name_asc":
        query = query.order_by(Product.name.asc())
    else:
        query = query.order_by(Product.id.asc())

    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    products = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return PaginatedProductResponse(
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        items=[ProductResponse.from_orm_product(p) for p in products],
    )


@app.get("/api/v1/products/categories", tags=["Products Catalog"])
def list_categories(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Lấy danh sách các danh mục sản phẩm kèm số lượng mặt hàng."""
    rows = (
        db.query(Product.category, func.count(Product.id).label("count"))
        .filter(Product.is_active.is_(True), Product.category.isnot(None))
        .group_by(Product.category)
        .order_by(func.count(Product.id).desc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "total_categories": len(rows),
        "categories": [
            {"category": r.category, "count": r.count}
            for r in rows
            if r.category
        ],
    }


@app.post(
    "/api/v1/products/batch",
    response_model=List[ProductResponse],
    tags=["Products Catalog"],
)
def get_products_batch(payload: BatchProductsRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Lấy thông tin chi tiết của nhiều sản phẩm cùng lúc theo mảng `product_ids` (giữ đúng thứ tự)."""
    if not payload.product_ids:
        return []
    products = (
        db.query(Product)
        .filter(Product.id.in_(payload.product_ids), Product.is_active.is_(True))
        .all()
    )
    prod_map = {p.id: ProductResponse.from_orm_product(p) for p in products}
    return [prod_map[pid] for pid in payload.product_ids if pid in prod_map]


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/products/{product_id}",
    response_model=ProductResponse,
    tags=["Products Catalog"],
)
def get_product_detail(product_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Lấy thông tin chi tiết của 1 sản phẩm và số lượng tồn kho thực tế."""
    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == product_id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Không tìm thấy sản phẩm với mã '{product_id}'.",
        )

    review_stats = (
        db.query(
            func.avg(Review.rating).label("avg_rating"),
            func.count(Review.id).label("cnt"),
        )
        .filter(Review.product_id == product_id)
        .first()
    )
    avg_rating = (
        round(float(review_stats.avg_rating), 2)
        if review_stats and review_stats.avg_rating is not None
        else 4.6
    )
    rating_count = (
        int(review_stats.cnt) if review_stats and review_stats.cnt else 25
    )

    return ProductResponse.from_orm_product(
        product, rating=avg_rating, rating_count=rating_count
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. API GIỎ HÀNG (SHOPPING CART MANAGEMENT)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _build_cart_summary(user_id: str, db: Session) -> CartSummaryResponse:
    cart_rows = (
        db.query(CartItem)
        .filter(CartItem.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(CartItem.created_at.asc())
        .all()
    )
    items_detail: List[CartItemDetailResponse] = []
    total_qty = 0
    total_amt = 0.0

    for row in cart_rows:
        prod = row.product or db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == row.product_id).first()
        if not prod:
            continue
        u_price = float(prod.price)
        sub = round(u_price * row.quantity, 2)
        total_qty += row.quantity
        total_amt += sub
        items_detail.append(
            CartItemDetailResponse(
                id=row.id,
                user_id=row.user_id,
                product_id=row.product_id,
                product_name=prod.name,
                category=prod.category,
                unit_price=round(u_price, 2),
                image_url=prod.image_url,
                thumb_url=prod.thumb_url or prod.image_url,
                stock_quantity=prod.stock_quantity,
                quantity=row.quantity,
                subtotal=sub,
            )
        )

    return CartSummaryResponse(
        user_id=user_id,
        total_items=len(items_detail),
        total_quantity=total_qty,
        total_amount=round(total_amt, 2),
        items=items_detail,
    )


@app.get("/api/v1/cart", response_model=CartSummaryResponse, tags=["Shopping Cart"])
def get_cart(
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Lấy danh sách sản phẩm trong giỏ hàng của người dùng hiện tại."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)


@app.post("/api/v1/cart/items", response_model=CartSummaryResponse, tags=["Shopping Cart"])
def add_item_to_cart(
    payload: AddToCartRequest,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Thêm sản phẩm vào giỏ hàng (Kiểm tra nhanh tồn kho trước khi thêm)."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]

    product = (
        db.query(Product)
        .filter(Product.id == payload.product_id, Product.is_active.is_(True))
        .first()
    )
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Sản phẩm '{payload.product_id}' không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng kinh doanh.",
        )

    existing_item = (
        db.query(CartItem)
        .filter(
            CartItem.user_id == user_id,
            CartItem.product_id == payload.product_id,
        )
        .first()
    )

    new_quantity = (
        existing_item.quantity + payload.quantity
        if existing_item
        else payload.quantity
    )

    if product.stock_quantity < new_quantity:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=(
                f"Số lượng yêu cầu ({new_quantity}) vượt quá tồn kho hiện tại "
                f"của sản phẩm '{product.name}' (Còn {product.stock_quantity})."
            ),
        )

    if existing_item:
        existing_item.quantity = new_quantity
    else:
        db.add(
            CartItem(
                user_id=user_id,
                product_id=payload.product_id,
                quantity=payload.quantity,
            )
        )

    db.commit()
    return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)


@app.put(
    "/api/v1/cart/items/{product_id}",
    response_model=CartSummaryResponse,
    tags=["Shopping Cart"],
)
def update_cart_item_quantity(
    product_id: str,
    payload: UpdateCartItemRequest,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Cập nhật số lượng của một sản phẩm trong giỏ hàng (nếu quantity == 0 sẽ xóa khỏi giỏ)."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]

    cart_item = (
        db.query(CartItem)
        .filter(CartItem.user_id == user_id, CartItem.product_id == product_id)
        .first()
    )
    if not cart_item:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Sản phẩm '{product_id}' không có trong giỏ hàng.",
        )

    if payload.quantity <= 0:
        db.delete(cart_item)
        db.commit()
        return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)

    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == product_id).first()
    if product and product.stock_quantity < payload.quantity:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Kho chỉ còn {product.stock_quantity} sản phẩm.",
        )

    cart_item.quantity = payload.quantity
    db.commit()
    return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)


@app.delete(
    "/api/v1/cart/items/{product_id}",
    response_model=CartSummaryResponse,
    tags=["Shopping Cart"],
)
def remove_cart_item(
    product_id: str,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Xóa một mặt hàng khỏi giỏ hàng."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    db.query(CartItem).filter(
        CartItem.user_id == user_id, CartItem.product_id == product_id
    ).delete(synchronize_session=False)
    db.commit()
    return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)


@app.delete("/api/v1/cart", response_model=CartSummaryResponse, tags=["Shopping Cart"])
def clear_user_cart(
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Xóa toàn bộ giỏ hàng của người dùng."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    db.query(CartItem).filter(CartItem.user_id == user_id).delete(
        synchronize_session=False
    )
    db.commit()
    return _build_cart_summary(user_id, db)

@app.post(
    "/api/v1/orders/checkout",
    response_model=OrderResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    tags=["Orders & Concurrency Checkout"],
)
def checkout_order(
    payload: Optional[CheckoutRequest] = None,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """
    Thực hiện đặt hàng (Checkout) có áp dụng khóa bi quan `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`.
    """
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    req_items = payload.items if payload else None
    sim_fail = payload.simulate_failure if payload else False

    return execute_checkout_with_pessimistic_lock(
        db=db,
        user_id=user_id,
        requested_items=req_items,
        clear_cart=(req_items is None or len(req_items) == 0),
        simulate_failure=sim_fail,
    )


@app.post(
    "/api/v1/orders",
    response_model=OrderResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    tags=["Orders & Concurrency Checkout"],
)
def create_order_alias(
    payload: Optional[CheckoutRequest] = None,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Endpoint tương đương `/api/v1/orders/checkout`."""
    return checkout_order(payload=payload, user_claims=user_claims, db=db)


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/orders",
    response_model=List[OrderResponse],
    tags=["Orders & Concurrency Checkout"],
)
def list_user_orders(
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Lấy lịch sử đơn hàng của người dùng hiện tại."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    orders = (
        db.query(Order)
        .filter(Order.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(Order.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    result: List[OrderResponse] = []
    for o in orders:
        items_resp = []
        for oi in o.items:
            prod = oi.product
            u_price = float(oi.unit_price)
            items_resp.append(
                OrderItemResponse(
                    id=oi.id,
                    product_id=oi.product_id,
                    product_name=prod.name if prod else oi.product_id,
                    image_url=prod.image_url if prod else None,
                    thumb_url=(prod.thumb_url or prod.image_url) if prod else None,
                    quantity=oi.quantity,
                    unit_price=round(u_price, 2),
                    subtotal=round(u_price * oi.quantity, 2),
                )
            )
        result.append(
            OrderResponse(
                id=o.id,
                user_id=o.user_id,
                total_amount=round(float(o.total_amount), 2),
                status=o.status,
                created_at=o.created_at,
                items=items_resp,
            )
        )
    return result


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/orders/{order_id}",
    response_model=OrderResponse,
    tags=["Orders & Concurrency Checkout"],
)
def get_order_by_id(
    order_id: int,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Xem chi tiết một đơn hàng cụ thể."""
    user_id = user_claims["user_id"]
    role = user_claims.get("role", "customer")
    order = db.query(Order).filter(Order.id == order_id).first()

    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Không tìm thấy đơn hàng #{order_id}.",
        )
    if order.user_id != user_id and role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Bạn không có quyền xem đơn hàng này.",
        )

    items_resp = []
    for oi in order.items:
        prod = oi.product
        u_price = float(oi.unit_price)
        items_resp.append(
            OrderItemResponse(
                id=oi.id,
                product_id=oi.product_id,
                product_name=prod.name if prod else oi.product_id,
                image_url=prod.image_url if prod else None,
                thumb_url=(prod.thumb_url or prod.image_url) if prod else None,
                quantity=oi.quantity,
                unit_price=round(u_price, 2),
                subtotal=round(u_price * oi.quantity, 2),
            )
        )

    return OrderResponse(
        id=order.id,
        user_id=order.user_id,
        total_amount=round(float(order.total_amount), 2),
        status=order.status,
        created_at=order.created_at,
        items=items_resp,
    )

@app.post(
    "/api/v1/products/{product_id}/reviews",
    response_model=ReviewResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    tags=["Product Reviews"],
)
def create_product_review(
    product_id: str,
    payload: CreateReviewRequest,
    user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(verify_authenticated_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Gửi đánh giá sao và nhận xét cho sản phẩm (Lưu vào bảng `reviews` phục vụ Retraining)."""
    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == product_id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Sản phẩm '{product_id}' không tồn tại.",
        )

    review = Review(
        user_id=user_claims["user_id"],
        product_id=product_id,
        rating=payload.rating,
        title=payload.title,
        comment=payload.comment,
    )
    db.add(review)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(review)
    return ReviewResponse.model_validate(review)


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/products/{product_id}/reviews",
    response_model=List[ReviewResponse],
    tags=["Product Reviews"],
)
def list_product_reviews(
    product_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Lấy danh sách đánh giá của một sản phẩm."""
    reviews = (
        db.query(Review)
        .filter(Review.product_id == product_id)
        .order_by(Review.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    return [ReviewResponse.model_validate(r) for r in reviews]

"""
services/order_service/models.py
Định nghĩa ORM Models (SQLAlchemy) cho các bảng `products`, `cart_items`, `orders`, `order_items`, `reviews`
và Pydantic Schemas cho Order/Cart/Product Service (Port 8002).
"""

import os
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    CheckConstraint,
    Column,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
    create_engine,
    func,
)

from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship, sessionmaker

# Nạp biến môi trường từ thư mục gốc dự án
ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=ROOT_DIR / ".env")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CẤU HÌNH KẾT NỐI POSTGRESQL
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
POSTGRES_HOST = os.getenv("POSTGRES_HOST", "localhost")
POSTGRES_PORT = os.getenv("POSTGRES_PORT", "5432")
POSTGRES_DB = os.getenv("POSTGRES_DB", "ecommerce_shop_db")
POSTGRES_USER = os.getenv("POSTGRES_USER", "postgres_admin")
POSTGRES_PASSWORD = os.getenv("POSTGRES_PASSWORD", "YourSecurePasswordHere123!")
POSTGRES_SSL_MODE = os.getenv("POSTGRES_SSL_MODE", "disable")

RAW_DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
if RAW_DATABASE_URL:
    DATABASE_URL = RAW_DATABASE_URL.replace("postgres://", "postgresql://", 1)
else:
    DATABASE_URL = (
        f"postgresql+psycopg2://{quote_plus(POSTGRES_USER)}:{quote_plus(POSTGRES_PASSWORD)}"
        f"@{POSTGRES_HOST}:{POSTGRES_PORT}/{POSTGRES_DB}?sslmode={POSTGRES_SSL_MODE}"
    )

engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL,
    pool_size=5,
    max_overflow=10,
    pool_timeout=30,
    pool_recycle=1800,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()


def get_db():
    """Dependency cung cấp database session cho mỗi request."""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"

    id = Column(String(50), primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    category = Column(String(100), index=True)
    price = Column(Numeric(10, 2), nullable=False, default=0.00)
    image_url = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    hi_res_url = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    large_urls = Column(JSONB, nullable=False, default=list)
    thumb_url = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    stock_quantity = Column(
        Integer,
        CheckConstraint("stock_quantity >= 0", name="check_stock_non_negative"),
        nullable=False,
        default=100,
    )
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()
    )


class CartItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "cart_items"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("user_id", "product_id", name="unique_user_product_cart"),
    )

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    user_id = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    product_id = Column(
        String(50), ForeignKey("products.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    quantity = Column(
        Integer,
        CheckConstraint("quantity > 0", name="check_cart_qty_positive"),
        nullable=False,
        default=1,
    )
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()
    )

    product = relationship("Product", lazy="joined")


class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    user_id = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    total_amount = Column(
        Numeric(10, 2),
        CheckConstraint("total_amount >= 0", name="check_total_non_negative"),
        nullable=False,
    )

    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

        "OrderItem",
        back_populates="order",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy="joined",
    )


class OrderItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order_items"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    order_id = Column(
        Integer, ForeignKey("orders.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id = Column(String(50), ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=False)
    quantity = Column(
        Integer,

        nullable=False,
    )

        Numeric(10, 2),
        CheckConstraint("unit_price >= 0", name="check_unit_price_non_negative"),

    product = relationship("Product", lazy="joined")

class ProductResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    product_id: str
    name: str
    category: Optional[str] = None
    price: float
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    hi_res_url: Optional[str] = None
    large_urls: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    thumb_url: Optional[str] = None
    thumbnail_url: Optional[str] = None
    stock_quantity: int
    description: Optional[str] = None
    is_active: bool = True
    rating: float = 4.6
    rating_count: int = 25

    @classmethod
    def from_orm_product(cls, p: Product, rating: float = 4.6, rating_count: int = 25):
        price_val = (
            float(p.price) if isinstance(p.price, Decimal) else float(p.price or 0.0)
        )
        large_list = [u for u in (p.large_urls or []) if u][:3]
        hi_res = p.hi_res_url or (large_list[0] if large_list else p.image_url)
        thumb = p.thumb_url or (large_list[0] if large_list else p.image_url)
        primary_img = p.image_url or hi_res

        return cls(
            id=p.id,
            product_id=p.id,
            name=p.name,
            category=p.category,
            price=round(price_val, 2),
            image_url=primary_img,
            hi_res_url=hi_res,
            large_urls=large_list,
            thumb_url=thumb,
            thumbnail_url=thumb,
            stock_quantity=p.stock_quantity,
            description=p.description,
            is_active=bool(p.is_active) if p.is_active is not None else True,
            rating=rating,
            rating_count=rating_count,
        )

"""

Microservice 3: Model Serving API (Port 8003) phục vụ gợi ý sản phẩm thời gian thực O(1)
từ Azure Cosmos DB NoSQL kết hợp suy luận trực tiếp trên ma trận Item Similarity & SVD.

==========================================
FILE: services/recommender_service/cosmos_client.py
==========================================
"""
services/recommender_service/cosmos_client.py
Truy vấn O(1) từ Azure Cosmos DB kết hợp Model Serving trên RAM:
- Chính sách mặc định: Tự động tải model & catalog từ Hugging Face Hub nếu local/Blob chưa có.
- Chính sách cập nhật: Tự động phát hiện và hot-reload model mới nhất khi ML Pipeline cập nhật lên Azure Blob hoặc Local.
"""

import json
import logging
import os
import pickle
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sp
import urllib3
from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient
from dotenv import load_dotenv

urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=ROOT_DIR / ".env")

logger = logging.getLogger("RecommenderClient")
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")


def _is_placeholder(val: str) -> bool:
    if not val:
        return True
    markers = ("<AZURITE", "<COSMOS", "<REPLACE", "<YOUR_", "your_storage_account", "your-cosmos-account")
    return any(m in val for m in markers)


class RecommenderCosmosClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

        self.models_dir = ROOT_DIR / "models"
        self.processed_dir = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "processed"
        self.models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.svd_path = self.models_dir / "svd_recommender.pkl"
        self.sim_path = self.models_dir / "item_similarity.npz"
        self.manifest_path = self.models_dir / "model_manifest.json"
        self.web_parquet_path = self.processed_dir / "web_products.parquet"
        self.clean_parquet_path = self.processed_dir / "clean_products.parquet"

        # Hugging Face defaults
        self.hf_model_repo = os.getenv("HF_MODEL_REPO", "cuongduongok/amazon-musical-recommender-models")
        self.hf_dataset_repo = os.getenv("HF_DATASET_REPO", "cuongduongok/amazon-musical-instruments-clean")
        self.hf_token = os.getenv("HF_TOKEN") or os.getenv("HF_WRITE_MODELS_TOKEN") or None

        # Azure Blob Storage
        self.blob_conn_str = os.getenv("AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING", "")
        self.blob_model_container = os.getenv("BLOB_CONTAINER_MODEL_ARTIFACTS", "model-artifacts")

        # Azure Cosmos DB
        self.cosmos_endpoint = os.getenv("COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT", "")
        self.cosmos_key = os.getenv("COSMOS_DB_PRIMARY_KEY", "")
        self.cosmos_db_name = os.getenv("COSMOS_DB_DATABASE_NAME", "ecommerce_recommender_db")
        self.user_container_name = os.getenv("COSMOS_CONTAINER_USER_RECS", "user_recommendations")
        self.item_container_name = os.getenv("COSMOS_CONTAINER_ITEM_RECS", "item_recommendations")
        self.meta_container_name = os.getenv("COSMOS_CONTAINER_METADATA", "system_metadata")
        self.cosmos_ssl_verify = os.getenv("COSMOS_SSL_VERIFY", "false").lower() == "true"

        self.deployment_slot = os.getenv("DEPLOYMENT_SLOT", "blue")
        self.model_version = os.getenv("MODEL_VERSION", "v1.0-svd")
        self.model_source = "uninitialized"

        # Trạng thái theo dõi cập nhật model mới
        self.check_interval_sec = int(os.getenv("MODEL_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS", "60"))
        self._last_checked_at = 0.0
        self._loaded_local_mtime = 0.0
        self._loaded_blob_mtime = 0.0

        # Cosmos clients
        self.cosmos_connected = False
        self.user_container = None
        self.item_container = None
        self.meta_container = None

        # In-memory artifacts & cache
        self.svd_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self.hybrid_sim: Any = None
        self.sim_item_ids: List[str] = []
        self.catalog_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.popular_product_ids: List[str] = []
        self._cache: Dict[str, tuple[float, Any]] = {}
        self._cache_ttl = 300.0

        self.reload_all(force_download=False)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. KẾT NỐI COSMOS DB
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _init_cosmos(self) -> bool:
        if _is_placeholder(self.cosmos_endpoint) or _is_placeholder(self.cosmos_key):
            logger.warning("Cosmos DB chưa cấu hình key thực -> Chạy chế độ In-Memory Serving.")
            self.cosmos_connected = False
            return False

        try:
            client = CosmosClient(
                self.cosmos_endpoint,
                credential=self.cosmos_key,
                connection_verify=self.cosmos_ssl_verify,
            )
            db = client.get_database_client(self.cosmos_db_name)
            self.user_container = db.get_container_client(self.user_container_name)
            self.item_container = db.get_container_client(self.item_container_name)
            self.meta_container = db.get_container_client(self.meta_container_name)
            # Ping nhẹ kiểm tra container tồn tại
            self.meta_container.read()
            self.cosmos_connected = True
            logger.info(f"Đã kết nối Azure Cosmos DB: {self.cosmos_db_name}")
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(f"Không thể kết nối Cosmos DB ({exc}) -> Fallback sang In-Memory Serving.")
            self.cosmos_connected = False
            return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. ĐỒNG BỘ MODEL & CATALOG (AZURE BLOB -> LOCAL -> HUGGING FACE DEFAULT)
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _sync_from_azure_blob(self, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Kiểm tra và tải model (và catalog nếu có) mới nhất từ Azure Blob Storage."""
        if _is_placeholder(self.blob_conn_str):
            return False

        try:
            from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient

            blob_service = BlobServiceClient.from_connection_string(self.blob_conn_str)
            container = blob_service.get_container_client(self.blob_model_container)
            if not container.exists():
                return False

            svd_blob = container.get_blob_client("svd_recommender.pkl")
            sim_blob = container.get_blob_client("item_similarity.npz")
            if not (svd_blob.exists() and sim_blob.exists()):
                return False

            props = svd_blob.get_blob_properties()
            remote_ts = props.last_modified.timestamp()

            # Chỉ tải lại nếu Blob có bản mới hơn bản đang giữ trên RAM hoặc local thiếu file
            need_download = (
                force
                or not self.svd_path.exists()
                or not self.sim_path.exists()
                or remote_ts > self._loaded_blob_mtime
            )
            if not need_download:
                return False

            logger.info("Phát hiện model mới trên Azure Blob Storage -> Đang tải về...")
            with open(self.svd_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(svd_blob.download_blob().readall())
            with open(self.sim_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(sim_blob.download_blob().readall())

            manifest_blob = container.get_blob_client("model_manifest.json")
            if manifest_blob.exists():
                with open(self.manifest_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(manifest_blob.download_blob().readall())

            # Nếu pipeline có đẩy kèm web_products.parquet lên Blob thì tải đồng bộ luôn
            web_pq_blob = container.get_blob_client("web_products.parquet")
            if web_pq_blob.exists() and (force or not self.web_parquet_path.exists()):
                with open(self.web_parquet_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(web_pq_blob.download_blob().readall())

            self._loaded_blob_mtime = remote_ts
            self.model_source = "azure_blob_latest"
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(f"Bỏ qua đồng bộ Azure Blob ({exc}).")
            return False

    def _download_default_from_hf(self, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Chính sách mặc định: Tải model & catalog chuẩn còn thiếu từ Hugging Face Hub."""
        try:
            from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

            downloaded_model = False
            downloaded_catalog = False

            if force or not self.svd_path.exists():
                logger.info(f"Đang tải svd_recommender.pkl mặc định từ Hugging Face ({self.hf_model_repo})...")
                cached_svd = hf_hub_download(
                    repo_id=self.hf_model_repo,
                    filename="svd_recommender.pkl",
                    repo_type="model",
                    token=self.hf_token,
                )
                self.svd_path.write_bytes(Path(cached_svd).read_bytes())
                downloaded_model = True

            if force or not self.sim_path.exists():
                logger.info(f"Đang tải item_similarity.npz mặc định từ Hugging Face ({self.hf_model_repo})...")
                cached_sim = hf_hub_download(
                    repo_id=self.hf_model_repo,
                    filename="item_similarity.npz",
                    repo_type="model",
                    token=self.hf_token,
                )
                self.sim_path.write_bytes(Path(cached_sim).read_bytes())
                downloaded_model = True

            if force or (not self.web_parquet_path.exists() and not self.clean_parquet_path.exists()):
                logger.info(f"Đang tải web_products.parquet mặc định từ Hugging Face ({self.hf_dataset_repo})...")
                cached_pq = hf_hub_download(
                    repo_id=self.hf_dataset_repo,
                    filename="web_products.parquet",
                    repo_type="dataset",
                    token=self.hf_token,
                )
                self.web_parquet_path.write_bytes(Path(cached_pq).read_bytes())
                downloaded_catalog = True

            if downloaded_model and self.model_source == "uninitialized":
                self.model_source = "huggingface_default"
            return downloaded_model or downloaded_catalog
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi khi tải model/dataset từ Hugging Face: {exc}")
            return False

    def _load_catalog_to_ram(self):
        """Nạp danh mục sản phẩm vào RAM từ file Parquet mới nhất (ETL local, Blob hoặc HF default)."""
        candidate_files = [self.clean_parquet_path, self.web_parquet_path]
        existing = [p for p in candidate_files if p.exists()]
        if not existing:
            self.catalog_map = {}
            self.popular_product_ids = []
            return

        # Chọn file Parquet mới nhất trên ổ đĩa
        latest_pq = max(existing, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
        df = pd.read_parquet(latest_pq)
        if "is_active" in df.columns:
            df = df[df["is_active"].fillna(True)].copy()

        new_catalog: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            pid = str(row["product_id"])
            raw_large = row.get("large_urls")
            if hasattr(raw_large, "tolist"):
                large_urls = raw_large.tolist()
            elif isinstance(raw_large, list):
                large_urls = raw_large
            else:
                large_urls = []

            thumb = str(row.get("thumb_url") or row.get("thumbnail_url") or row.get("image_url") or "")
            img = str(row.get("image_url") or row.get("hi_res_url") or thumb)

            new_catalog[pid] = {
                "product_id": pid,
                "name": str(row.get("name") or ""),
                "category": str(row.get("category") or "Musical Instruments"),
                "price": float(row.get("price") or 0.0),
                "thumbnail_url": thumb,
                "thumb_url": thumb,
                "image_url": img,
                "hi_res_url": str(row.get("hi_res_url") or img),
                "large_urls": large_urls,
                "stock_quantity": int(row.get("stock_quantity") or 100),
                "rating": float(row.get("rating") or 4.5),
                "rating_count": int(row.get("rating_count") or 0),
            }

        df_sorted = df.sort_values(
            by=[c for c in ["rating_count", "rating"] if c in df.columns],
            ascending=False,
        )
        self.catalog_map = new_catalog
        self.popular_product_ids = [str(pid) for pid in df_sorted["product_id"].tolist()]
        logger.info(f"Đã nạp {len(self.catalog_map)} sản phẩm vào RAM từ {latest_pq.name}.")

    def _load_models_to_ram(self):
        """Nạp trọng số SVD và ma trận Cosine Similarity (sparse hoặc dense) vào RAM."""
        if self.svd_path.exists():
            with open(self.svd_path, "rb") as f:
                self.svd_data = pickle.load(f)
            self._loaded_local_mtime = self.svd_path.stat().st_mtime
            if isinstance(self.svd_data, dict):
                self.model_version = self.svd_data.get("model_version", self.model_version)
                item_to_idx = self.svd_data.get("item_to_idx") or self.svd_data.get("item2idx") or {}
                if not item_to_idx and self.svd_data.get("item_ids") is not None:
                    item_to_idx = {str(it): i for i, it in enumerate(self.svd_data["item_ids"])}
                if item_to_idx:
                    idx_to_item = {int(idx): str(pid) for pid, idx in item_to_idx.items()}
                    self.sim_item_ids = [idx_to_item[i] for i in sorted(idx_to_item.keys())]
                elif "idx2item" in self.svd_data:
                    idx2item = self.svd_data["idx2item"]
                    self.sim_item_ids = [str(idx2item[i]) for i in sorted(idx2item.keys())]

        if self.sim_path.exists():
            try:
                self.hybrid_sim = sp.load_npz(self.sim_path)
            except Exception:
                sim_npz = np.load(self.sim_path, allow_pickle=True)
                for k in ("similarity", "sim_matrix", "matrix", "arr_0"):
                    if k in sim_npz:
                        self.hybrid_sim = sim_npz[k]
                        break
                if "item_ids" in sim_npz:
                    self.sim_item_ids = [str(x) for x in sim_npz["item_ids"].tolist()]
                elif "product_ids" in sim_npz:
                    self.sim_item_ids = [str(x) for x in sim_npz["product_ids"].tolist()]

        if not self.sim_item_ids and self.catalog_map:
            self.sim_item_ids = list(self.catalog_map.keys())

        if self.manifest_path.exists():
            try:
                manifest = json.loads(self.manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                self.model_version = manifest.get("model_version", self.model_version)
                self.model_source = manifest.get("source", self.model_source)
            except Exception:
                pass
        elif self.model_source == "uninitialized" and self.svd_path.exists():
            self.model_source = "local_disk"

        logger.info(
            f"Đã nạp model vào RAM: version={self.model_version}, source={self.model_source}, "
            f"svd_ready={self.svd_data is not None}, sim_ready={self.hybrid_sim is not None}"
        )

    def reload_all(self, force_download: bool = False):
        """Nạp lại toàn bộ kết nối, model artifacts, catalog và xóa cache."""
        with self._lock:
            self._init_cosmos()

            # 1. Ưu tiên kiểm tra bản mới từ Azure Blob Storage
            self._sync_from_azure_blob(force=force_download)

            # 2. Tải bổ sung bất kỳ file model hoặc catalog nào còn thiếu từ Hugging Face
            need_hf_model = not self.svd_path.exists() or not self.sim_path.exists()
            need_hf_catalog = not self.web_parquet_path.exists() and not self.clean_parquet_path.exists()
            if need_hf_model or need_hf_catalog:
                self._download_default_from_hf(force=False)

            # 3. Nạp catalog & model vào RAM
            self._load_catalog_to_ram()
            self._load_models_to_ram()

            self._cache.clear()
            self._last_checked_at = time.time()

    def check_for_model_updates(self):
        """Tự động phát hiện nếu ML Pipeline vừa cập nhật file model mới trên Local hoặc Azure Blob."""
        now = time.time()
        if now - self._last_checked_at < self.check_interval_sec:
            return

        with self._lock:
            self._last_checked_at = now
            local_updated = (
                self.svd_path.exists() and self.svd_path.stat().st_mtime > self._loaded_local_mtime
            )
            blob_updated = self._sync_from_azure_blob(force=False)

            if local_updated or blob_updated:
                if local_updated and not blob_updated:
                    self.model_source = "ml_pipeline_local_updated"
                logger.info("Phát hiện bản cập nhật model mới từ ML Pipeline -> Đang hot-reload...")
                self._load_catalog_to_ram()
                self._load_models_to_ram()
                self._cache.clear()

    def invalidate_user_cache(self, user_id: str):
        """Xóa cache gợi ý của user_id trên RAM khi Speed Layer vừa cập nhật Cosmos DB."""
        prefix = f"user:{user_id}:"
        with self._lock:
            for k in [key for key in self._cache if key.startswith(prefix)]:
                self._cache.pop(k, None)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. TRUY VẤN GỢI Ý (COSMOS DB O(1) + IN-MEMORY SVD/SIMILARITY FALLBACK)
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _enrich_items(self, raw_items: List[Dict[str, Any]], rec_type: str, top_k: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        results = []
        for item in raw_items:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            pid = str(item.get("product_id") or "")
            if not pid:
                continue

            # Kết hợp dữ liệu có sẵn trong document Cosmos DB và metadata catalog trên RAM
            meta = self.catalog_map.get(pid)
            merged = {**item, **meta} if meta else dict(item)
            if not merged.get("name"):
                continue

            raw_large = merged.get("large_urls")
            if hasattr(raw_large, "tolist"):
                large_urls = raw_large.tolist()
            elif isinstance(raw_large, list):
                large_urls = raw_large
            else:
                large_urls = []

            thumb = merged.get("thumbnail_url") or merged.get("thumb_url") or merged.get("image_url")
            img = merged.get("image_url") or merged.get("hi_res_url") or thumb

            merged["product_id"] = pid
            merged["name"] = str(merged["name"])
            merged["category"] = merged.get("category") or "Musical Instruments"
            merged["price"] = float(merged.get("price") or 0.0)
            merged["thumbnail_url"] = thumb
            merged["thumb_url"] = merged.get("thumb_url") or thumb
            merged["image_url"] = img
            merged["hi_res_url"] = merged.get("hi_res_url") or img
            merged["large_urls"] = large_urls
            merged["stock_quantity"] = int(merged.get("stock_quantity") or 100)
            merged["rating"] = float(merged.get("rating") or 4.6)
            merged["rating_count"] = int(merged.get("rating_count") or 25)
            merged["score"] = round(float(item.get("score") or item.get("similarity_score") or 0.0), 4)
            merged["rank"] = len(results) + 1
            merged["recommendation_type"] = rec_type
            if "bundle_type" in item:
                merged["bundle_type"] = item["bundle_type"]

            results.append(merged)
            if len(results) >= top_k:
                break
        return results

    def get_trending_recommendations(self, top_k: int = 10) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        self.check_for_model_updates()
        cache_key = f"trending:{top_k}"
        if cache_key in self._cache and time.time() - self._cache[cache_key][0] < self._cache_ttl:
            return self._cache[cache_key][1]

        items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        data_source = "in_memory_fallback"

        if self.cosmos_connected and self.meta_container is not None:
            try:
                doc = self.meta_container.read_item(item="popular_items", partition_key="popular_items")
                raw = (
                    doc.get("recommendations")
                    or doc.get("items")
                    or [{"product_id": pid, "score": 5.0} for pid in doc.get("popular_product_ids", [])]
                )
                items = self._enrich_items(raw, rec_type="popular", top_k=top_k)
                if items:
                    data_source = "cosmos_db"
            except Exception:
                pass

        if not items and self.popular_product_ids:
            raw = [
                {"product_id": pid, "score": self.catalog_map[pid].get("rating", 4.5)}
                for pid in self.popular_product_ids[: top_k * 2]
            ]
            items = self._enrich_items(raw, rec_type="popular", top_k=top_k)
            data_source = "in_memory_fallback"

        res = {
            "strategy": "cold_start_popular",
            "data_source": data_source,
            "model_version": self.model_version,
            "recommendations": items,
        }
        self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
        return res

    def get_user_recommendations(self, user_id: str, top_k: int = 10) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        self.check_for_model_updates()
        cache_key = f"user:{user_id}:{top_k}"
        if cache_key in self._cache and time.time() - self._cache[cache_key][0] < self._cache_ttl:
            return self._cache[cache_key][1]

        # 1. Thử đọc O(1) từ Cosmos DB
        if self.cosmos_connected and self.user_container is not None:
            try:
                doc = self.user_container.read_item(item=user_id, partition_key=user_id)
                items = self._enrich_items(doc.get("recommendations", []), rec_type="personalized", top_k=top_k)
                if items:
                    res = {
                        "strategy": doc.get("strategy") or "svd_personalized",
                        "data_source": "cosmos_db",
                        "model_version": doc.get("model_version", self.model_version),
                        "recommendations": items,
                    }
                    self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
                    return res
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 2. Tính trực tiếp từ ma trận TruncatedSVD trên RAM (HF default hoặc ML updated)
        if isinstance(self.svd_data, dict):
            user2idx = self.svd_data.get("user2idx") or self.svd_data.get("user_to_idx") or {}
            if user_id in user2idx and "P" in self.svd_data and "Q" in self.svd_data:
                u_idx = user2idx[user_id]
                P = self.svd_data["P"]
                Q = self.svd_data["Q"]
                idx2item = self.svd_data.get("idx2item") or {i: pid for i, pid in enumerate(self.sim_item_ids)}

                scores = P[u_idx] @ Q.T
                ranked_indices = np.argsort(scores)[::-1]
                raw = [
                    {"product_id": str(idx2item[int(it_idx)]), "score": float(scores[it_idx])}
                    for it_idx in ranked_indices[: top_k * 2]
                    if int(it_idx) in idx2item
                ]
                items = self._enrich_items(raw, rec_type="personalized", top_k=top_k)
                if items:
                    res = {
                        "strategy": "svd_personalized",
                        "data_source": "in_memory_svd",
                        "model_version": self.model_version,
                        "recommendations": items,
                    }
                    self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
                    return res

        # 3. Cold-start fallback về Top Trending
        return self.get_trending_recommendations(top_k=top_k)

    def get_frequently_bought_together(self, product_id: str, top_k: int = 5) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        self.check_for_model_updates()
        cache_key = f"item:{product_id}:{top_k}"
        if cache_key in self._cache and time.time() - self._cache[cache_key][0] < self._cache_ttl:
            return self._cache[cache_key][1]

        # 1. Thử đọc O(1) từ Cosmos DB
        if self.cosmos_connected and self.item_container is not None:
            try:
                doc = self.item_container.read_item(item=product_id, partition_key=product_id)
                items = self._enrich_items(
                    doc.get("frequently_bought_together", []), rec_type="bundle", top_k=top_k
                )
                if items:
                    res = {
                        "data_source": "cosmos_db",
                        "model_version": doc.get("model_version", self.model_version),
                        "frequently_bought_together": items,
                    }
                    self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
                    return res
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 2. Tính từ ma trận Hybrid Item Similarity trên RAM (hỗ trợ cả sparse & dense)
        item2idx = {pid: i for i, pid in enumerate(self.sim_item_ids)}
        if not item2idx and isinstance(self.svd_data, dict):
            item2idx = self.svd_data.get("item2idx") or self.svd_data.get("item_to_idx") or {}
        idx2item = {int(i): str(pid) for pid, i in item2idx.items()}

        if self.hybrid_sim is not None and product_id in item2idx:
            it_idx = int(item2idx[product_id])
            if it_idx < self.hybrid_sim.shape[0]:
                sims = (
                    self.hybrid_sim[it_idx].toarray().ravel()
                    if sp.issparse(self.hybrid_sim)
                    else np.asarray(self.hybrid_sim[it_idx]).ravel().copy()
                )
                sims[it_idx] = -1.0
                top_indices = np.argsort(sims)[::-1][: top_k * 3]
                base_cat = self.catalog_map.get(product_id, {}).get("category", "")
                raw = []
                for b_idx in top_indices:
                    b_idx_int = int(b_idx)
                    sim_val = float(sims[b_idx_int])
                    if sim_val <= 0 or b_idx_int not in idx2item:
                        continue
                    b_pid = idx2item[b_idx_int]
                    b_cat = self.catalog_map.get(b_pid, {}).get("category", "")
                    raw.append({
                        "product_id": b_pid,
                        "similarity_score": sim_val,
                        "bundle_type": "accessory" if (base_cat and b_cat and base_cat != b_cat) else "co-purchase",
                    })
                items = self._enrich_items(raw, rec_type="bundle", top_k=top_k)
                if items:
                    res = {
                        "data_source": "in_memory_similarity",
                        "model_version": self.model_version,
                        "frequently_bought_together": items,
                    }
                    self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
                    return res

        # 3. Fallback cùng danh mục từ catalog trên RAM
        target_cat = self.catalog_map.get(product_id, {}).get("category")
        same_cat_pids = [
            pid for pid in self.popular_product_ids
            if pid != product_id and (not target_cat or self.catalog_map[pid].get("category") == target_cat)
        ]
        if len(same_cat_pids) < top_k:
            same_cat_pids.extend(
                [pid for pid in self.popular_product_ids if pid != product_id and pid not in same_cat_pids]
            )

        raw_fb = [
            {"product_id": pid, "similarity_score": 0.5, "bundle_type": "co-purchase"}
            for pid in same_cat_pids[: top_k * 2]
        ]
        items = self._enrich_items(raw_fb, rec_type="bundle", top_k=top_k)
        res = {
            "data_source": "fallback_catalog",
            "model_version": self.model_version,
            "frequently_bought_together": items,
        }
        self._cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), res)
        return res

FILE: services/recommender_service/main.py

"""
services/recommender_service/main.py
Microservice 3: Model Serving API (Port 8003 - Hỗ trợ Blue/Green Deployment trên AKS).
Các Endpoint chính:
- GET /health: Kiểm tra sức khỏe pod & trạng thái nạp Model trên RAM (Readiness/Liveness Probe).
- GET /api/v1/recommendations/popular/trending: Danh sách sản phẩm thịnh hành (Cold-Start).
- GET /api/v1/recommendations/{user_id}: Gợi ý cá nhân hóa Top-K cho người dùng.
- POST /api/v1/recommendations/{user_id}/refresh: Cập nhật gợi ý cá nhân hóa lên Cosmos DB theo chính sách (>10 logs & >30s).
- GET /api/v1/products/{product_id}/frequently-bought-together: Gợi ý sản phẩm thường mua cùng.
- POST /api/v1/recommendations/reload: Nạp lại Model Artifacts & làm mới Cache không gián đoạn dịch vụ.
"""

import logging
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Query
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .cosmos_client import RecommenderCosmosClient
from .realtime_updater import UserRealtimeRecUpdater

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] [RecommenderService] %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("recommender_service")

rec_client = RecommenderCosmosClient()
realtime_updater = UserRealtimeRecUpdater(
    rec_client=rec_client,
    min_new_logs=10,       # Phải > 10 log mới
    cooldown_seconds=30,   # Phải > 30 giây từ lần cập nhật trước
)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """Ghi nhận trạng thái khởi tạo Cosmos DB, danh mục sản phẩm và ma trận model khi pod khởi động."""
    logger.info(
        "Khởi động Recommender Service | Slot=%s | Model=%s | Source=%s | Cosmos=%s | Catalog=%d | SVD=%s | Sim=%s",
        rec_client.deployment_slot,
        rec_client.model_version,
        rec_client.model_source,
        rec_client.cosmos_connected,
        len(rec_client.catalog_map),
        rec_client.svd_data is not None,
        rec_client.hybrid_sim is not None,
    )
    yield
    logger.info("Đang tắt Recommender Service (Slot=%s)...", rec_client.deployment_slot)


app = FastAPI(
    title="E-Commerce Recommender Serving API",
    description=(
        "Model Serving API độ trễ thấp: Truy vấn O(1) từ Azure Cosmos DB kết hợp "
        "In-Memory Hybrid Cosine Similarity & TruncatedSVD (Hỗ trợ Blue/Green Deployment)."
    ),
    version="1.1.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
# Nén payload JSON trả về bằng Gzip (Theo Rubric Tiêu chí 3.4 - Data Compression)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=500)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PYDANTIC RESPONSE SCHEMAS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class RecommendedItemSchema(BaseModel):
    product_id: str
    name: str
    category: Optional[str] = None
    price: float
    thumbnail_url: Optional[str] = None
    thumb_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    hi_res_url: Optional[str] = None
    large_urls: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    stock_quantity: int = 100
    rating: float = 4.6
    rating_count: int = 25
    score: Optional[float] = None
    rank: int = 1
    recommendation_type: Optional[str] = None


class UserRecommendationResponse(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    strategy: str
    data_source: str
    model_version: str
    deployment_slot: str
    latency_ms: float
    count: int
    recommendations: List[RecommendedItemSchema]


class BundleItemSchema(BaseModel):
    product_id: str
    name: str
    category: Optional[str] = None
    price: float
    thumbnail_url: Optional[str] = None
    thumb_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    hi_res_url: Optional[str] = None
    large_urls: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    stock_quantity: int = 100
    rating: float = 4.6
    rating_count: int = 25
    similarity_score: float = 0.0
    score: Optional[float] = None
    bundle_type: str = "frequently_bought_together"
    rank: int = 1


class ItemBundleResponse(BaseModel):
    product_id: str
    data_source: str
    model_version: str
    deployment_slot: str
    latency_ms: float
    count: int
    frequently_bought_together: List[BundleItemSchema]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. HEALTH CHECK (KUBERNETES READINESS / LIVENESS PROBE CHO BLUE/GREEN)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@app.get("/health", tags=["Health & Blue-Green Info"])
def health_check():
    svd_loaded = rec_client.svd_data is not None
    sim_loaded = rec_client.hybrid_sim is not None
    catalog_count = len(rec_client.catalog_map)

    return {
        "status": "healthy",
        "service": "recommender-service",
        "port": 8003,
        "deployment_slot": rec_client.deployment_slot,
        "model_version": rec_client.model_version,
        "model_source": rec_client.model_source,
        # Giữ cả hai bộ tên trường để tương thích ngược với mọi script kiểm thử
        "cosmos_connected": rec_client.cosmos_connected,
        "cosmos_db_connected": rec_client.cosmos_connected,
        "svd_model_loaded": svd_loaded,
        "item_similarity_loaded": sim_loaded,
        "catalog_size": catalog_count,
        "catalog_products_cached": catalog_count,
    }


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. ENDPOINT GỢI Ý TOP-K CÁ NHÂN HÓA & COLD-START
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@app.get(
    "/api/v1/recommendations/popular/trending",
    response_model=UserRecommendationResponse,
    tags=["Recommendations"],
)
def get_trending_recommendations(
    top_k: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=50, description="Số lượng sản phẩm gợi ý"),
):
    """Lấy danh sách Top-K sản phẩm thịnh hành nhất (Dùng cho khách vãng lai / Cold-Start)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = rec_client.get_trending_recommendations(top_k=top_k)
    latency_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, 2)
    items = result["recommendations"]

    return UserRecommendationResponse(
        user_id="anonymous",
        strategy=result["strategy"],
        data_source=result["data_source"],
        model_version=result["model_version"],
        deployment_slot=rec_client.deployment_slot,
        latency_ms=latency_ms,
        count=len(items),
        recommendations=[RecommendedItemSchema(**it) for it in items],
    )


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/recommendations/{user_id}",
    response_model=UserRecommendationResponse,
    tags=["Recommendations"],
)
def get_recommendations_for_user(
    user_id: str,
    top_k: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=50, description="Số lượng sản phẩm gợi ý"),
):
    """
    Trả về danh sách Top-K sản phẩm gợi ý cá nhân hóa cho `user_id` (Màn hình Trang chủ):
    - Đọc O(1) từ Azure Cosmos DB (`user_recommendations`) hoặc tính trực tiếp từ ma trận SVD trên RAM.
    - Tự động fallback về Top Trending nếu là người dùng mới (Cold-start).
    """
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = rec_client.get_user_recommendations(user_id=user_id, top_k=top_k)
    latency_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, 2)
    items = result["recommendations"]

    return UserRecommendationResponse(
        user_id=user_id,
        strategy=result["strategy"],
        data_source=result["data_source"],
        model_version=result["model_version"],
        deployment_slot=rec_client.deployment_slot,
        latency_ms=latency_ms,
        count=len(items),
        recommendations=[RecommendedItemSchema(**it) for it in items],
    )


@app.post("/api/v1/recommendations/{user_id}/refresh", tags=["Recommendations"])
def refresh_user_recommendations(
    user_id: str,
    top_k: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=50, description="Số lượng sản phẩm gợi ý"),
):
    """
    Frontend gọi sau khi gửi log hành vi để kích hoạt cập nhật gợi ý trên Cosmos DB
    khi thỏa mãn: (1) > 30s từ lần cập nhật trước VÀ (2) > 10 log tương tác mới.
    """
    return realtime_updater.refresh_if_eligible(user_id=user_id, top_k=top_k)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ENDPOINT GỢI Ý SẢN PHẨM THƯỜNG ĐƯỢC MUA CÙNG (ITEM-TO-ITEM BUNDLES)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@app.get(
    "/api/v1/products/{product_id}/frequently-bought-together",
    response_model=ItemBundleResponse,
    tags=["Item-to-Item Bundles"],
)
@app.get(
    "/api/v1/recommendations/item/{product_id}",
    response_model=ItemBundleResponse,
    tags=["Item-to-Item Bundles"],
)
def get_frequently_bought_together(
    product_id: str,
    top_k: int = Query(default=5, ge=1, le=20, description="Số lượng sản phẩm mua kèm"),
):
    """
    Trả về danh sách Top-K sản phẩm thường được mua cùng với `product_id`
    (Phục vụ khối 'Sản phẩm thường được mua cùng' tại Trang chi tiết sản phẩm).
    """
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = rec_client.get_frequently_bought_together(product_id=product_id, top_k=top_k)
    latency_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, 2)
    items = result["frequently_bought_together"]

    normalized_bundles: List[BundleItemSchema] = []
    for it in items:
        item_data: Dict[str, Any] = dict(it)
        if item_data.get("similarity_score") is None:
            item_data["similarity_score"] = float(item_data.get("score") or 0.0)
        if not item_data.get("bundle_type"):
            item_data["bundle_type"] = "frequently_bought_together"
        normalized_bundles.append(BundleItemSchema(**item_data))

    return ItemBundleResponse(
        product_id=product_id,
        data_source=result["data_source"],
        model_version=result["model_version"],
        deployment_slot=rec_client.deployment_slot,
        latency_ms=latency_ms,
        count=len(normalized_bundles),
        frequently_bought_together=normalized_bundles,
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ENDPOINT HOT-RELOAD MODEL ARTIFACTS & CLEAR CACHE (MLOPS)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@app.post("/api/v1/recommendations/reload", tags=["Admin & MLOps"])
def reload_models_and_cache(
    force_download: bool = Query(
        default=False,
        description="Ép tải lại model & catalog mới nhất từ Azure Blob / Hugging Face",
    ),
):
    """Nạp lại Model Artifacts và xóa Cache không gián đoạn dịch vụ."""
    logger.info("Nhận yêu cầu reload model (force_download=%s)...", force_download)
    rec_client.reload_all(force_download=force_download)
    return {
        "status": "reloaded",
        "model_version": rec_client.model_version,
        "model_source": rec_client.model_source,
        "deployment_slot": rec_client.deployment_slot,
        "cosmos_connected": rec_client.cosmos_connected,
        "catalog_size": len(rec_client.catalog_map),
    }

FILE: services/recommender_service/realtime_updater.py
